Name: Sanrio Plush Set (Custom Furniture)
Author: chichisribbons
Description:
This mod uses the Custom Furniture mod to add 2x1 block plushes of various sanrio characters. Note: this mod is a work in progress and will be updated with more characters over time! There are two versions of this mod. The old version will not be updated, but it will remain available for download.
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/950183973819121665/1095065122256453755/kuromi.png[/img]
The old version has the following characters: Pompompurin, Keroppi, Badtz Maru, My Melody, Kuromi, and Pochacco
The new version has the following characters: Keroppi, Badtz Maru, My Melody, Kuromi, and Hangyodon

Special requests for characters to be added to the NEW VERSION ONLY can be made through nexusmods' posts feature, emailed to psoymilk@gmail.com, or on twitter @psoymilk. Thank you for your patience and all of the downloads!

Downloads.Description: This mod update adds Keroppi, My Melody, Badtz Maru, and Pochacco to the previous file which contained Kuromi and Pompompurin. It also changes the plushes from 3x1 to 2x1.
